name: 01-combined-desktop
description: Combined duties show care, money and management
assert: document.title === "Home · Geneus Health" && ["Visits in progress", "Billing & collections", "Facility management"].every(t=>document.body.innerText.includes(t)) && document.querySelectorAll("main").length === 1

name: 02-combined-phone
description: Phone preserves visits and presents work before metrics

label: More navigation
name: 03-more-phone
description: More contains the union of permitted duties
More dismisses with Escape and restores focus

name: 04-readonly-small-phone
description: Read-only duties preserve reading without record actions

name: 05-cashier-home
description: Cashier sees collection work without clinical worklists
Billing account opens from dashboard route
Empty payment is blocked without posting

name: 06-payment-discard-guard
description: Escape protects unfinished payment amounts

name: 07-payment-review
description: Payment review shows amount before writing

name: 08-payment-receipt
description: Payment posts once and opens a receipt

name: 09-filtered-reports
description: Reports apply the visible patient search
assert: document.body.innerText.includes("No collections match these filters.") && !document.querySelector("select").parentElement.parentElement.innerText.includes("Fee entries")

name: 10-reception-home
description: Reception receives booking work and registration action

name: 11-booking-drilldown
description: Dashboard booking group opens the correct list
Register entry opens

name: 12-register-validation
description: Register validation stays inside the dialog with no success toast

name: 13-register-review
description: Register has explicit review before permanent entry
Register entry is saved with attribution

name: 14-never-synced
description: Sync makes no loss or acceptance claims
assert: !document.body.innerText.includes('Nothing needs a decision') && !document.body.innerText.includes('Lost') && document.body.innerText.includes('Never synced') && document.body.innerText.includes('does not confirm')

name: 15-sync-review
description: Refused records remain visible independently of queue count
assert: document.body.innerText.includes("Records need review") && document.body.innerText.includes("Needs a decision")

name: 16-stock-live
description: Stock uses stored opening balances and movements

name: 17-stock-review
description: Stock review precedes append-only movement

name: 18-stock-saved
description: Stock movement is persisted and reflected in balance

name: 19-monthly-live
description: Monthly report uses real stored data and states completeness limits

name: 20-monthly-small-phone
description: Monthly reporting fits the phone

name: 21-facility-booking
description: Reception can book directly from the facility schedule
Booking retains the selected patient

name: 22-booking-saved
description: Facility booking saves through the existing repository

name: 23-settings
description: Settings replaces the permanent onboarding checklist

name: 24-staff-directory
description: One staff directory applies name search

name: 25-roster
description: Roster is a separate dated view

name: 26-staff-url
description: Staff details can be opened from a stable URL

name: 27-devices
description: Device management uses synced device records

name: 28-revoke-review
description: Device revocation requires a deliberate connected confirmation

name: 29-provider-failure
description: Provider failure ends the loading state next to its setup step

name: 30-handoff-review
description: Handoff completion explains its limited consequence
assert: document.querySelector("dialog[open]").innerText.includes("Record any clinical result or medication separately")

name: 31-handoff-complete
description: Completed handoff leaves the unit queue
